Before each fetch, it checks if either limit would be exceeded; if so, it records a terminal event with type 'budget_exhausted', the exhausted resource (requests or bytes), the current counters, the limits, and a hash of the agent's state (excluding budget counters) to ensure reproducibility. The terminal event is appended to an immutable audit log.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
